question: Should admin proxy-credential PUT now fail closed on loose legacy payload shapes such as `enabled: null` and non-email `principalId`, or should a compatibility path be preserved?
rationale: The patch improves a credential activation boundary, but it changes what existing control-plane clients can submit; CI cannot decide whether that admin API compatibility break is acceptable.

options.title: Accept strict validation
options.body: Merge the fail-closed behavior after proof and changelog cleanup, treating malformed credential activation as invalid input.

options.title: Preserve loose-client compatibility
options.body: Keep existing client shapes working with a compatibility mode or migration path while still canonicalizing stored credentials.

options.title: Pause for contract discussion
options.body: Hold this PR until the admin credential mutation contract is documented or explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Accept strict validation
recommendation.body: Merge the fail-closed behavior after proof and changelog cleanup, treating malformed credential activation as invalid input.
